name: BedrockConnect + MCXboxBroadcast
author: support@pterodactyl.io
description: All-in-one low-maintenance Minecraft Bedrock server gateway combining BedrockConnect and MCXboxBroadcast. Allows console players (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch) to join custom servers via Xbox Live Friends and access a custom server list. Features an autonomous background supervisor that monitors process health, periodically checks for upstream GitHub releases, verifies downloads, and performs zero-maintenance rolling restarts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ==============================================================================
# BedrockConnect + MCXboxBroadcast Instant Installer
# Container: ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:debian
# Server Mount: /mnt/server
# ==============================================================================
set -e

echo "--------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Initializing BedrockConnect + MCXboxBroadcast environment..."
echo "--------------------------------------------------------"

cd /mnt/server

echo "--------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed in < 0.1s!"
echo "Supervisor and binaries are embedded in the container image."
echo "Application files and updates are managed on container start."
echo "--------------------------------------------------------"

variables.name: Update Check Interval (Minutes)
variables.description: How frequently in minutes the supervisor polls GitHub for new BedrockConnect and MCXboxBroadcast releases. Minimum is 5 minutes.

variables.name: Auto-Update Restart
variables.description: Whether to perform an immediate in-container graceful restart when an update is verified and installed (true), or wait for the next manual reboot (false).

variables.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
variables.description: Optional GitHub PAT to prevent rate-limiting when checking updates if your host machine shares a public IP with many services.

variables.name: BedrockConnect Memory (MB)
variables.description: Maximum RAM (heap memory) in megabytes allocated to the BedrockConnect Java process.

variables.name: MCXboxBroadcast Memory (MB)
variables.description: Maximum RAM (heap memory) in megabytes allocated to the MCXboxBroadcast Java process.
